title: Fresh Bar 50/50 Lemon & Lime 10ml E-Liquid By Pukka Juice
description: Lemon and Lime from Fresh Bar is that classic, cordial combo of bright, tangy citrus flavours balanced in perfect harmony. Treat your tastebuds to the timeless taste of zesty Lemon and zingy, vibrant Lime and carry a little Mediterranean sunshine with you wherever you go. This delicious 50:50 E-Liquid from Fresh Bar offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. This type of e-liquid hits the sweet spot of plenty of flavour and impressive cloud production and work well in almost every type of vape kit, making it the most versatile type of e-liquid at Vapestore. 50:50 e-liquids typically contain traditional Freebase nicotine, which offers the classic e-liquid experience. With Freebase e-liquids, the flavours are often more intense with a stronger, more tactile throat hit than you would find with nicotine salts, or high-VG e-liquids. This makes them a great choice for newer vapers seeking that familiar ‘smoking’ sensation. Fresh Bar are a brand of e-liquids from vape masters Pukka Juice, an award-winning UK e-liquid company behind some of the most popular e-liquids today. From nic salts, to 50/50 eliquids, Fresh Bar e-liquids draw inspiration from the most popular disposable vape bar flavours.
